## Prescribed faces and their reapplication (a wall boundary condition) {#sec-ch10-prescribed}

### Summary

At a wall the face flux is not computed: it is prescribed. A reflecting wall passes no mass and no energy, so
those rows of the wall face must be zero whatever a producer wrote there. Producers such as diffusion add their
flux on every face, walls included. The register therefore applies the prescription itself, after the producers
and before the divergence reads the totals, and books what it removed, so the budget can see it.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Overwrite the prescribed rows of the wall faces with their values and book the change
([-@eq-ch10-prescribed-book]).

**Data.** Per direction: the wall planes and each plane's free rows, or a mask and values shaped like
$\mathbf T_d$; the amount `boundary.prescribed`.

**Placement.** After each direction's posts, again after all sources' posts and before the divergence, and once
more after the implicit correction when it ran or a writer marked $x_1$.

**Activation.** A wall boundary condition supplies the planes; without one the apply is a no-op.

**Guarantee / limits.** No producer's post on a wall face reaches the state increment.

**Evidence.** The Tests layer of this section.
:::

Local symbols: $\mathcal W_d$ is the set of prescribed faces and rows of direction $d$; $\mathbf T^{\mathrm{p}}_d$ is
their prescribed value; $\mathbf M_{\mathrm{p}}$ is the booked amount, one value per row.

### Derivation

On a prescribed face and row $(f, r) \in \mathcal W_d$ the apply sets $\mathbf T_d[r, f] \leftarrow
\mathbf T^{\mathrm{p}}_d[r, f]$ and leaves every other face. The change it makes, weighted by the face area $A_f$
($\mathrm{m}^2$), is booked as a rate per row:

$$
\mathbf M_{\mathrm{p}}[r] \mathrel{+}= \sum_{f:\,(f,r)\in\mathcal W_d} A_f
\left(\mathbf T^{\mathrm{p}}_d[r,f] - \mathbf T_d[r,f]^{\mathrm{before}}\right).
$$ {#eq-ch10-prescribed-book}

The booking is {{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp FluxRegister::overwrite_ >}}, called by `apply_prescribed`.

The rate is a flux times an area, so after the stage fold (@sec-ch10-amounts) it is an amount of the row per step.
A wall-plane prescription has $\mathbf T^{\mathrm{p}}_d = 0$ on its prescribed rows; a mask prescription carries its
own values. The kept parts of the direction are prescribed with the same faces and values, but only the total
books.

### Numerical method

The apply runs at four places in a hydro stage: on $x_1$ after the seam reconciliation, on $x_2$ and $x_3$ after
the panel seams, on every active direction after the sources' posts (so a source's post on a wall face is removed
before the divergence), and on $x_1$ once more after the implicit correction. The last one runs when the implicit
correction ran, because that correction writes $\mathbf T_1$ directly, or when the written mark of $x_1$ is set:
every `add`, `scale` and `replace` sets the mark and every apply clears it, so a writer after the
pre-divergence apply (such as the settling carry of the positivity limiter, @sec-ch08-carry) calls for the
apply. Otherwise the faces are already prescribed and the apply is skipped. The scalar module applies its own
register's prescription the same way. @fig-ch10-register-order shows the order.

### Code

| what | code link | symbol | switch |
|---|---|---|---|
| the wall planes and free rows | {{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp FluxRegister::set_prescribed_walls >}} | `set_prescribed_walls` | wall boundary |
| a mask and values | {{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp FluxRegister::set_prescribed >}} | `set_prescribed` | none |
| the apply and its booking | {{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp FluxRegister::apply_prescribed >}} | `apply_prescribed` | none |
| the write-and-book | {{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp FluxRegister::overwrite_ >}} | `overwrite_` | none |
| the written mark | {{< code src/hydro/flux_register.hpp FluxRegister::written_since_prescribed >}} | `written_since_prescribed` | none |
| the hydro call sites | {{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}} | `forward` | none |

: The code of prescribed faces. {#tbl-ch10-prescribed-code}

Walk-through: `apply_prescribed` takes the wall-plane path when planes were set (gather the planes, zero their
prescribed rows, prescribe the kept parts plane by plane, then `overwrite_` writes and books), else the mask path
(`where(mask, value, total)` through `overwrite_`). Either way it clears the written mark. `overwrite_` stops with
an error if the register was reset without its coordinate, because it needs $A_f$.

### Limits

The prescription is per face and row; a prescription that depends on the state within the stage is outside this
scheme. Which boundary conditions supply planes, and with which free rows, is the boundary chapter's. Switch
combinations are in @sec-ch12-matrix.
